prompt: One square polished detailed painterly Balkan folklore encyclopedia illustration of a PSOGLAV. The dog face has NO ordinary paired side eyes, no side eye sockets; those two side areas are continuous dark fur, the ONLY eye is central. Humanlike muscular torso and two humanlike arms, but exactly TWO LONG HORSE LEGS ending in two dark split? NO, horse SINGLE SOLID HOOVES, as source specifies horse legs. Low cold reflected cave light reveals iron teeth, fur and muscular mixed anatomy; fierce predatory hungry sinister presence, no cute mascot. No extra eyes, human face, human feet, four horse legs, wings, horns, extra arms, weapon, victims, blood, corpses, text, labels, border or watermark.
visual_requirements: Dog head with one forehead eye
Human torso and arms with two horse legs
Dark gem-rich cave and predatory aura

visual_review.notes: Observed dog-headed human-torso hybrid with exactly ONE large centered forehead eye and no side eyes, metallic iron teeth, two arms and TWO horse lower legs ending in single solid equine hooves. Full hybrid body visible in dark mineral-rich cave, hostile snarl and tense stance convey hungry sunless-cave demon.
